company.name: Symple
company.shortDescription: Symple is a cloud platform for business payments.
company.description:
Symple is transforming how business purchases are made. Founded in 2015 by Stanford and USC engineers, Symple is dedicated to making the benefits of cloud computing and machine learning available to all businesses; from the local pub to the large manufacturer.

We're on a mission to help small-to-large businesses discover new products, automate their purchasing processes and make digital payments. By moving all those manual, paper-driven workflows onto our online platform, you can focus on the things that matter.
